name: tiwaa-growth-labs
description: Tiwaa Growth Labs website: Rust (site generator + Cloudflare Worker), Cloudflare D1

scripts.dev:worker: wrangler d1 migrations apply tiwaa-leads --local && wrangler dev
scripts.db:leads: wrangler d1 execute tiwaa-leads --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, form, name, phone, email, service, page, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign FROM leads ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.db:utm: wrangler d1 execute tiwaa-leads --remote --command "SELECT LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(utm_source,''),'(direct)')) AS source, LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(utm_medium,''),'(none)')) AS medium, COALESCE(NULLIF(utm_campaign,''),'-') AS campaign, COUNT(*) AS leads, SUM(status='won') AS won FROM leads WHERE created_at > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY leads DESC"
